WITH root_causes AS (
  SELECT 'fraud_claim' AS code, 21 AS narratives UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dispute_mishandled', 33 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'servicing_error', 26 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'account_restricted', 21 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'terms_not_honored', 58 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'fee_charged', 25 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'credit_reporting', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'third_party', 2 UNION ALL

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN code NOT IN ('third_party','other','unclear') THEN narratives ELSE 0 END) AS total_with_cause,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN code IN ('terms_not_honored','dispute_mishandled') THEN narratives ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(CASE WHEN code NOT IN ('third_party','other','unclear') THEN narratives ELSE 0 END), 1) AS combined_share
FROM root_causes

outputs.final_text: The report is ready — it covers complaint volume, timely response rates, and relief rates across the top 10 credit card companies, with no single "worst" bank across all measures but clear standouts on each dimension.

report.title: Which Bank Has Been Worst for Credit Card Customers in 2026?
findings: Capital One received the most credit card complaints of any company — 6,857 from January to August 2026 — followed by Citibank (6,124) and Synchrony Financial (4,716). These three companies together account for the majority of complaints among the top 10.

Synchrony Financial had the lowest timely response rate among the top 10 companies at 93.4%, meaning roughly 1 in 15 complaints did not receive a timely response. All other top-10 companies were at 99.0% or above.

Barclays Bank Delaware had the lowest relief rate among the top 10 at 6.6% — meaning only 6.6% of closed complaints resulted in any relief for the consumer. JPMorgan Chase was next lowest at 19.6%, followed by Capital One at 21.6%.

Complaints about 'Problem with a purchase shown on your statement' were the top issue at Capital One (3,085), Citibank (3,320), and Bank of America (2,075). At Synchrony Financial, 'Fees or interest' was the second-largest issue with 1,403 complaints.

No single company stands out as worst across all dimensions: Capital One leads in raw complaint volume, Synchrony Financial had the most timely-response failures, and Barclays Bank Delaware provided the least consumer relief relative to complaints closed.
